context: Two friends reconnect after a stressful move
purpose: Catch up warmly; teach そろそろ/当初/前後/かける/至っ/聴く

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 久しぶり。そろそろ落ち着いた？
lines.en: Long time no see. Settling down by now?
lines.style: tender friend gently checking in, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、当初は大変だったけどね。
lines.en: Yeah, at first it was rough, though.
lines.style: relieved friend looking back, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 引っ越し前後はバタバタだったでしょ。
lines.en: Around the move it was hectic, right?
lines.style: sympathetic friend recalling the chaos, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほんと、いつも心配かけるよね。
lines.en: Really, I always make you worry.
lines.style: apologetic friend acknowledging the burden, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 当初の計画とは全然違ったね。
lines.en: It turned out totally unlike the original plan.
lines.style: wry friend noting how things shifted

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結局、今の結論に至ったよ。
lines.en: In the end, I arrived at where I am now.
lines.style: settled friend summing up his journey

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いい音楽でも聴く？ 落ち着くよ。
lines.en: Want to listen to some good music? It is calming.
lines.style: caring friend offering a soothing idea

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。最近は前後の予定も詰まってて。
lines.en: Sounds good. Lately my schedule before and after is packed.
lines.style: tired friend appreciating the break, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
